responsibility: This file is the executable C implementation of the m68k target backend’s core behavior for Motorola 680x0 and ColdFire. It supplies the target hooks and helper routines that complement m68k.md and m68k.h: target option override and feature gating, register usage setup, address decomposition/legitimacy and PIC/TLS handling, cost and scheduling callbacks, calling-convention decisions for arguments and return values, frame-layout computation plus prologue/epilogue and save/restore support, thunk and trampoline emission, constant and move output helpers, excess-precision and ABI-related policy, and other per-function code-generation decisions. In short, it owns the backend logic that consumes GCC RTL/tree target state and produces m68k-specific code-generation, scheduling, and ABI behavior that cannot be expressed declaratively in the machine description alone.
same_name_distinction: Implements the executable backend logic for the m68k stem: target hooks and helper routines in C for ABI decisions, frame layout, address legitimacy, scheduling, trampolines, and option-dependent behavior consumed at compile time. Unlike m68k.h, which provides macros, declarations, and target constants, m68k.md, which declares RTL instruction patterns and attributes, and m68k.opt, which defines command-line option records, this file contains the procedural implementation that ties those interfaces together.
